prerequisite: pass all eight Wave 7.177 linear 24-port gates on the same marked carrier
carrierModel: H=(U/2)n^T G^-1 n+u sum_i(1-cos theta_i) with the measured Gram-first G

modeSplit.rule: fit shared scale and U/u only on calibration modes; no mode-specific Kerr or frequency refits are allowed before scoring held-out modes

gates.name: harmonic fingerprint
gates.fit: one overall energy scale per calibrated U/u setting on the twelve calibration modes
gates.pass: held-out RMS relative residual <=0.005 and maximum relative residual <=0.01 across all three settings
gates.failMeaning: the measured quadratic metric does not generate the observed dynamics

gates.name: shared anharmonic fingerprint
gates.fit: one shared calibrated U/u model using calibration modes only
gates.pass: held-out 0-to-1 shifts match the frozen 24-coefficient pattern including projected mixing within 0.001 relative at U/u=0.001 and 0.0025 at U/u=0.01
gates.failMeaning: mode-specific Kerr physics or the wrong cosine-coordinate dictionary

gates.name: soft-gap join
gates.pass: softest transition agrees with the all-24-mode order-consistent target within 0.001 relative at U/u=0.001 and 0.0025 at U/u=0.01
gates.failMeaning: higher-order remainder, omitted hardware mode or non-cosine nonlinearity exceeds the declared window

gates.name: parity and two-tone ordering
gates.pass: the first transition is odd-drive active at every precision setting and the 1-to-2 ordering is reproduced without relabelling modes
gates.failMeaning: wrong low-energy sector or uncontrolled hybridization

gates.name: compact charge-dispersion control
gates.fit: sinusoidal offset-phase amplitude independently at each ratio
gates.pass: report the full profile and upper limit; no absolute amplitude promotion is allowed without a prefactor model; any resolved nonexponential or increasing trend under decreasing U/u rejects the ideal compact carrier
gates.failMeaning: uncontrolled phase slips, dissipation, offset-charge aliasing or ultraviolet junction structure

gates.name: held-out power stability
gates.pass: extrapolated zero-power centers from three drive powers remain inside the corresponding N1-N3 tolerance
gates.failMeaning: drive-induced Stark shift or saturation was mistaken for intrinsic spectrum

promotionAfterPass: commissioned nonlinear compact Leech-metric rotor carrier at the finite-device scope
notPromoted: thermodynamic bulk gap, 24 chiral edge modes, Leech rootlessness, inversion orbifold, Moonshine character, Monster defects or Griess product
established: a finite same-carrier packet that jointly tests the measured metric-to-dynamics dictionary, nonlinear cosine fingerprint, parity and compactness without mode-specific fitting
boundary: The numerical tolerances are preregistered engineering gates chosen above the known 0.0082-0.0852 percent theory-ladder discrepancies; they are not universal constants. N5 is a falsifying trend control, not an absolute tunnelling-amplitude theorem, because the instanton prefactor is unbounded.
epistemicStatus: executable proposed experiment with theorem-backed targets and explicitly conditional engineering tolerances
